messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: p95 latency > SLO (us-west model-serving) — alert id pd-4829. Auto-page threshold triggered.

pagerduty: @alice_oncall — new high-priority incident (pd-4829). Please ack.

alice_oncall: acked. I'm on it, grabbing metrics.

bob_sre: I see a sudden tail increase from 120ms -> 420ms p95 across the text-generation pool (svc: rwd-inference-usw). No error spike. CPU/GPU look normal but queue depth jumped.

charlie_infra: Autoscaler logs show multiple rejected scale-up requests due to node quota hit in the region (AWS us-west-2). Scaling attempted at 1825009920, 1825009960, both failed with quota error.

alice_oncall: ok that explains the queue. Initiating immediate mitigation: 1) enable regional fallthrough to eu-west for non-privacy flows, 2) temporarily increase batching timeout to reduce tokens/sec.

diane_support: FYI support ticket stream shows a handful of customer errors: ~7 sessions saw >5s response latency and a couple timeouts. No widespread 5xx yet. Tagging customers as potential impact.

bob_sre: rolling a fast reroute: set routing policy for low-priority tenants -> eu fallback (policy id: fallback-heatwave-01). Command: 
```
rbctl route update --service model-serving --priority low --policy fallback-heatwave-01
```
Doing it now.

alice_oncall: applied. Confirming route change in control plane.

charlie_infra: temporary knob: reduce max_batch_wait_ms from 50 -> 20 for the hot path to reduce queueing latency for short requests. Patch pushed to runtime config: 
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{"max_batch_wait_ms": 20}
```
Watch p95.

bob_sre: also enabling a compatible quantized model fallback for best-effort responses if primary model slots stay stuck. Deploying variant: redwood-gen-small-8q.

alice_oncall: good. Putting note to PagerDuty: we are mitigating via regional reroute + batching change + model fallback. Est impact limited to low-priority tenants; premium should be unaffected.

diane_support: notifying impacted customers with templated message: "We're investigating higher latency in US-West, requests may be routed to EU temporarily. We're working to restore capacity."

incident-bot: Update: autoscaler quota cleared at 1825010500 — AWS team manually increased limit. New nodes provisioning.

bob_sre: new nodes coming up, pool capacity rising. p95 trending down from 420ms -> 190ms over last minute.

alice_oncall: monitoring. If p95 < 200ms for 2 consecutive minutes we'll close the page.

charlie_infra: nodes healthy, KV cache warmed via proactive prefetch for hot keys. No 5xx observed.

diane_support: support notified customers updated. Minimal user-facing errors, majority of requests degraded but succeeded.

alice_oncall: closing loop: revert temporary batching after stabilization, scheduled follow-up ticket to add quota alarms and autoscaler circuit-breaker. Creating post-incident note.

pagerduty: Incident pd-4829 acknowledged -> resolved by alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: resolved. Postmortem task list: 1) quota alert and runbook 2) automated fallback to eu for non-compliant tenants 3) test autoscaler with quota-failure scenario 4) improve customer-facing metrics tagging. I'll assign and triage in the morning. :white_check_mark:
